refsection.title: Description
refsection.para:
The `SilikoSyntaxTreeNewBranch` function creates a new branch `SilikoSyntaxTreeNode` object.
* `Id` is the function identifier used by this branch node.

refsection.title: Return Values
refsection.para: `SilikoSyntaxTreeNewBranch` returns a pointer to a new branch `SilikoSyntaxTreeNode` object with the function identifier passed on success, or `NULL` if there was a memory error.
